thread:
maria-support: Customer reports free trial blocked when applying promo code KICKSTART24. Says they signed up with testuser@mailinator.com and got 'trial_onhold: fraud_check' in the UI. Can someone check? https://app.redwood.example/customer/acc_7722

alex-fraud: I pulled the risk log. Two rule hits: disposable_email (mailinator), dynamic_ip (ASN looks like cloud provider), and high velocity on cards. Score 78. Do we have the signup IP & headers?

maria-support: Signup IP is 185.220.101.23, from the support ticket. Customer claims it's a home connection. Email is mailinator.com. Card last4 4242 (test card). They want the trial to test evaluation.

alex-fraud: 185.220.101.23 resolves to OVH/Hetzner pool (ASN 16276). That's usually VPS/dyno. Combined w/ mailinator and test card, auto-flag will block. We can run quick checks: curl to events API: 

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOG_KEY" "https://logs.redwood.internal/events?acct=acc_7722&limit=20" | jq .hits[0]
```

That shows rule_hits: ["disposable_email","dyn_ip","card_velocity"].

sachin-ops: Adding server-side log excerpt: 

```
{"ts":"1925076543","acct":"acc_7722","evt":"signup","ip":"185.220.101.23","email":"testuser@mailinator.com","promo":"KICKSTART24","rule_score":78}
```

miriam-ts: For manual review, we need two things: proof of ownership (screenshot of an accepted payment or phone verification) and that the email is not disposable. If they can't provide that, recommend granting a limited 3-day trial with soft limits and monitoring. I can approve an override if Support flags it for T&S sign-off.

maria-support: Customer says they used mobile hotspot earlier; they can provide a selfie with the card and last4. I told them we'd escalate. What's the safe quick path to unblock for dev testing?

alex-fraud: Options: 1) Phone/SMS verify + accept verified email (not disposable) -> clear. 2) If they insist, we can apply a manual temporary grant: create a promo override in console w/ 72h expiry, quota tokens 1000, and set account tag `manual_reviewed:limited_trial`. Also add a watch rule for increased logging and auto-throttle.

support-bot: Escalation created: #TS-4317 - Manual trial override request for acc_7722. Assignee: miriam-ts.

miriam-ts: I'm taking it. I'll request the selfie + card last4. If verified, I'll apply a 3-day trial override and leave a note. If not, we should deny and advise KYC.

fraud-bot: Automated rule output: {"acct":"acc_7722","score":78,"hits":["disposable_email","dyn_ip","card_velocity"],"recommendation":"manual_review"}

maria-support: Customer sent selfie and a photo of the card (last4 matches). They also provided phone number + verification code.

miriam-ts: Verified phone OTP and card last4. Email still disposable but acceptable for now given KYC evidence. Applying override: 

```
POST /admin/accounts/acc_7722/override
{ "type":"trial_grant","duration_hours":72, "tokens":1000, "notes":"Manual 72h grant after KYC. tag:manual_reviewed:limited_trial" }
```

miriam-ts: Done. Trial granted at 1925076802. Added watch rule and tagged account. Leaving T&S note.

alex-fraud: Thanks. Please monitor for card re-use or velocity spikes. If any suspicious activity, revoke immediately.

maria-support: Customer confirmed they can access trial features now. Closing ticket once we confirm no abuse. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket #TS-4317 updated: status=resolved, note="72h manual trial granted after KYC. Monitor enabled."

miriam-ts: Closing here. Leave follow-up in weekly fraud sync for unusual promo use patterns.

alex-fraud: Adding recommended product action: consider denying KICKSTART24 for disposable emails or require phone verification at redemption.

maria-support: Noted, I'll add a doc in /support/playbooks for promo redemption checks.
